description: 薄荷色信息图串起基础款圆领短袖的主张、面料工艺、多色挂拍与尺码指数

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper sweep for packshots and hanging rows, studio wall #A9DFE1 for on-body scenes, solid brand block #1F9E8B for index and craft screens, matte info-card field #F4F1E9 for spec screens; one background per screen, no scenery
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, soft front-left key with large fill, gentle contact shadow grounding every garment, raking side light at 25-30 degrees to reveal knit loops and seam definition, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF and matte card field #F4F1E9, hairline rules and dotted rules as the only surface decoration
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bold Chinese display headline in #2D2D2D or #FFFFFF paired with one thin uppercase English kicker; label 14-18pt, headline 24-40pt; every rendered in-image string comes from selling_point or callout slots, never literal source copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, numbered circles, plus-sign bullets and 2px outlined tag pills, all in #1F9E8B on light fields or #FFFFFF on brand blocks
styleLock.presentationRules: garment front-facing at stable scale on an invisible form, laid flat, or hung on wooden hangers; on-body screens cropped below the chin or below the neck so no face is readable; silhouette never clipped by the frame edge
noDrift: no visible model face or identity
no garment redesign or added print graphics
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium fresh-basics menswear apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless product field #FFFFFF, studio wall #A9DFE1, brand block #1F9E8B and info card field #F4F1E9 with text in #2D2D2D; cool high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with large fill, gentle contact shadow grounding every garment, raking side light at 25-30 degrees to reveal knit texture and seams; modern geometric sans-serif with a bold Chinese display headline paired with one thin uppercase English kicker; thin single-weight line icons, numbered circles, plus bullets and 2px outlined tag pills in #1F9E8B; garments presented front-facing at stable scale on an invisible form, laid flat, or on wooden hangers, always cropped below the chin so no face is visible; consistent layout grid with hairline rules and generous margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible model face, no garment redesign.

provenance.notes: 源图为 10 屏竖版详情页长图切片，逐屏核对后判定主体确为男装上衣：屏 1-2 与屏 8-9 为成年男模身着圆领短袖针织上衣，屏 3 为针织布面微距并标注面料标签，屏 4-5 为编号工艺格（袖口、领口），屏 5-6 为同款多色木衣架挂拍，屏 6-7 为产品参数列表 + 版型/柔软/厚度三项指数条 + 胸围肩长袖长衣长五列尺码表，屏 10 为会员入口收口；既非童装也非贴身睡衣家居服，故维持 L1 男装 / L2 上衣，未改判。已剥离内容：原品牌与店铺名、模特面容与身份、夏季上新与会员折扣原文案、面料标签文字与其拼音、面料成分百分比与货号与吊牌价与整张尺码表数值与三项指数档位、 lorem 占位英文小字、二维码与会员入口、装饰棕榈叶与波浪线条图形、以及原薄荷绿版式的具体排版结构；源图所有数值一律改为 callout 占位符，产品一律以 product 占位符指代，穿着镜全部裁到下巴或颈部以下。
